text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... How disgraceful of me...
Whatever possessed me to lose my composure like that...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I found an item at the cafe called
"For the hardworking you! Near-Zero-Calorie Mont Blanc!"...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I bought this thinking I could eat it guilt-free even while watching my weight, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I got far too ahead of myself,
and my hand slipped...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah... My first Mont Blanc
in a whole month...

...There was an indescribable melancholy
drifting from Mejiro McQueen's back.
